quests.word: I'll skip the introductions since we've all met before, and jump straight into the agenda.
quests.textToSpeak: I'll skip the introductions since we've all met before, and jump straight into the agenda.

quests.correctAnswer: Accelerating (a sentence about skipping should itself skip along)

quests.explanation: The speaker promises to move quickly. A leisurely delivery would undo that promise before the meeting has even started.
quests.pacingRule: Accelerated Pacing: A sentence about saving time is delivered briskly.

quests.pacingRule: Decelerated Pacing: Flag the insight, and then slow down when you deliver it.

quests.word: So we took the bus, then the ferry, then another bus, and eventually we arrived, somewhere near midnight.
